provenance.queries: 20 symptoms written by colleagues working with the author, each with the writer's own label. Whether the writers had seen Round-1 material, or used writing tools, was not recorded; several topics overlap Round 1. No version of the system had been run on these queries before the pre-registered evaluation.
provenance.labels: Writer's labels used unchanged (mostly a single DTC per row, so scoring is strict). Modes: 15 symptom (DTC expected), 4 no_dtc (mechanical, correct behaviour = decline), 1 inconclusive (excluded from scoring). Flags on R16 and R18 in notes.
provenance.scoring: symptom rows: hit = any expected code, any decline is an error; no_dtc rows: decline is correct; inconclusive rows: reported, not scored. Report all-rows and a sensitivity analysis excluding R16 and R18.

queries.query: Vehicle takes several attempts to start in the morning. Once started, it runs reasonably well.
queries.notes: writer label: DTC-linked candidate; writer assessment: P00C6-00 — verify fuel-rail pressure during cranking

queries.query: Truck loses pulling power on steep inclines, especially with a heavy load.
queries.notes: writer label: DTC-linked candidate; writer assessment: P0087-00 — investigate fuel-pressure deviation

queries.query: Engine shakes at idle, and the driver says it feels like one cylinder is not contributing properly.
queries.notes: writer label: DTC-linked candidate; writer assessment: P0201-00 — investigate cylinder 1 injector circuit

queries.query: Temperature gauge behaves normally at first but suddenly jumps to an unusually high reading.
queries.notes: writer label: DTC-linked candidate; writer assessment: P0119-00 — investigate intermittent coolant-temperature signal

queries.query: Fuel economy has dropped, and the vehicle feels less responsive than it used to.
queries.notes: writer label: DTC-linked candidate; writer assessment: P0101-00 — check air-mass/charging-pressure plausibility

queries.query: Engine feels weak during overtaking, and the driver reports that acceleration is inconsistent.
queries.notes: writer label: DTC-linked candidate; writer assessment: P259F-00 / P259E-00 — investigate boost-control limits

queries.query: Pressing the accelerator sometimes produces very little response, although the engine continues running.
queries.notes: writer label: DTC-linked candidate; writer assessment: P2135-00 — check pedal-position signal compatibility

queries.query: Vehicle smokes more than usual and runs roughly at low engine speeds.
queries.notes: writer label: DTC-linked candidate; writer assessment: P042E-00 — investigate EGR operation

queries.query: Engine occasionally cuts out while driving and may take time to restart.
queries.notes: writer label: DTC-linked candidate; writer assessment: P0336-00 — investigate disturbed crankshaft signal

queries.query: Engine cranks longer than usual and sometimes struggles to start after being switched off briefly.
queries.notes: writer label: DTC-linked candidate; writer assessment: P0341-00 — investigate disturbed camshaft signal

queries.query: Speedometer intermittently drops to zero while the vehicle is moving.
queries.notes: writer label: DTC-linked candidate; writer assessment: P0500-1F — investigate vehicle-speed signal plausibility

queries.query: Starter does not operate consistently; turning the key sometimes produces no cranking.
queries.notes: writer label: DTC-linked candidate; writer assessment: P0A1B-13 — inspect starter-control circuit

queries.query: Driver reports a fuel-filter warning after refuelling, with occasional hesitation under load.
queries.notes: writer label: DTC-linked candidate; writer assessment: P2264-00 — check water-in-fuel detection and fuel condition

queries.query: DPF warning appears, and the vehicle gradually becomes less powerful during continued use.
queries.notes: writer label: DTC-linked candidate; writer assessment: P244B-00 — investigate DPF restriction

queries.query: Vehicle repeatedly fails to complete its regeneration process, with the warning returning after driving.
queries.notes: writer label: DTC-linked candidate; writer assessment: P2458-00 — investigate regeneration lockout

queries.query: Engine oil level is rising between services, and the oil smells strongly of diesel.
queries.notes: writer label: Mechanical / no-DTC expected; writer assessment: Investigate fuel dilution, injector leakage and regeneration history | FLAG: concept overlaps Round-1 Q46 (oil dilution), which informed the development of refinement A - not independent of A; report results with and without this row

queries.query: Engine temperature rises mainly during long climbs, but returns toward normal on level roads.
queries.notes: writer label: Mechanical / no-DTC expected; writer assessment: Inspect cooling system, radiator airflow, coolant circulation and load

queries.query: There is a loud hissing sound under acceleration, accompanied by black smoke and weak pulling power.
queries.notes: writer label: Mechanical / no-DTC expected; writer assessment: Inspect charge-air hoses, intercooler and intake leaks | FLAG: arguable label: a charge-air leak often triggers air-mass/boost codes (Round-1 Q56 was labelled P0101-00/P259F-00); writer's no-DTC label kept; under A-narrow smoke/noise give advice, not a decline

queries.query: A metallic knocking noise is heard under heavy load, but idle quality and starting appear normal.
queries.notes: writer label: Mechanical / no-DTC expected; writer assessment: Investigate combustion, injector condition and mechanical causes

queries.query: Engine cranks at normal speed but starts only after repeated attempts; fuel supply and electrical connections appear intact.
queries.notes: writer label: Mechanical / inconclusive; writer assessment: Check fuel-filter restriction, air ingress, fuel quality and compression before assigning a DTC | FLAG: writer marked inconclusive - excluded from scoring, reported separately
